optimizations_identified.title: Python 3.12 Multi-threaded Process Fork Deprecation Warning
optimizations_identified.description: In multi-threaded test environments, ProcessPoolExecutor invocations trigger DeprecationWarning due to default fork start method.
optimizations_identified.remediation: Configure explicit 'spawn' multiprocessing context or thread-safe pool handling in brain_agents_orchestrator.py and main.py.

optimizations_identified.title: WAL File Size Accumulation under High-Frequency Tick Ingestion
optimizations_identified.description: During 24x7 VPS executions with thousands of tick writes, SQLite WAL log file growth requires explicit background WAL checkpointing.
optimizations_identified.remediation: Add automated WAL auto-checkpointing (PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(PASSIVE)) and WAL file threshold management in DatabaseInfrastructure.

round_goal: Eliminate process fork warnings, enforce automated WAL log management, and maintain 100% test green status.
